overview: A coming-of-age tale told in a magical-realism style about a teenage boy, Morten, who feels out of place among his wealthier classmates. While they enjoy expensive school trips, he spends his days in his family’s dilapidated farmhouse, finding solace only in a camera gifted by his grandfather, a lens through which the world seems brighter. When two girls enter his life - Miia, a street artist, and Emilie, a mysterious girl from the marsh - Morten’s world is turned upside down as he struggles to understand both his first stirrings of love and the changing world around him.
title: Morten

data.overview: "Morten" on maagilise realismi võtmes jutustatud eneseleidmise lugu teismelisest poisist Mortenist, kes ei tunne end jõukamate klassikaaslaste seas just eriti kindlalt. Samal ajal, kui teised saavad lubada kalleid klassireise, möödub tema argipäev lagunenud talus kehvades tingimustes. Morteni ainsaks varanduseks ja lohutuseks on vanaisa kingitud fotokaamera – läbi selle objektiivi tundub maailm hetkekski põnevam ja helgem. Kui tema ellu ilmuvad kaks tüdrukut -  tänavakunstiga tegelev Miia ning Emilie - salapärane tüdruk rabast, pöördub Morteni maailm pea peale. Ta peab ühtäkki hakkama mõtestama enda jaoks nii tärkavat armumise tunnet kui maailma enda ümber.

A coming-of-age tale told in a magical-realism style about a teenage boy, Morten, who feels out of place among his wealthier classmates. While they enjoy expensive school trips, he spends his days in his family’s dilapidated farmhouse, finding solace only in a camera gifted by his grandfather, a lens through which the world seems brighter. When two girls enter his life - Miia, a street artist, and Emilie, a mysterious girl from the marsh - Morten’s world is turned upside down as he struggles to understand both his first stirrings of love and the changing world around him.
